evidence.title: Establish the source IG contract
criteria: Schema represents sources/regions, clauses with stable aspects and semantic groups, relations, gaps, origin bindings, coverage, profiles, runs, reviews and snapshots.
ID and revision hash rules are explicit and deterministic; anonymous identities do not depend on array position.
Source representation distinguishes review, coverage and executable readiness; source-level opaque is accepted without granting execution.
State, causal history, parameters, persistent choices, reactions, continuations, costs, geometry, tables, chance and visibility have addressable source representations; no generic payload-only claim.
No importer, formal interpreter, compiler or game logic is implemented; record open formal-language decisions for IG-3A.

evidence.title: Freeze input and source manifests
criteria: Every input file has path, bytes, hash, role and availability; detect change during copy.
Missing 36 historically configured source paths are rechecked and reported, not silently substituted.
Pin the promoted PDF as a new selected source with identity_to_wgu_original unknown.
Reject path escapes, linked paths and unintended source reads; no neighbour writes.

evidence.title: Import all WGU collections losslessly
criteria: Import rules, terms, nested procedures, tables, relations, ambiguities, changes, questions, terminology and auxiliary files.
Unsafe YAML tags and duplicate keys fail with locations; errors do not become empty collections.
Every unknown field/file is preserved or explicitly diagnosed; WGU verified/complete/resolved remains imported metadata.
Refs/see remain navigation; questions are evaluation candidates, not battle scenarios or accepted expected results.

evidence.title: Persist identities and deterministic exports
criteria: Repeated identical bytes yield identical identities and export content; timestamps are outside canonical hashes.
Reordering anonymous terms/relations preserves identities when unambiguous; collisions become review gaps.
Many-to-many origin bindings preserve file/field locations; wildcard and subpoint references have exact targets or explicit unresolved scope.
Export validates revision/hash closure and never inherits semantic approval.

evidence.title: Accept full KB input accounting
criteria: No file/record/unknown field silently disappears; report processed/raw/error counts separately.
Structural snapshot can be sealed with gaps; no claim of source coverage or semantic correctness.
Document missing sources and required subsequent reconciliation; preserve mixed editions.
